text:
maria (AE): Quick sync re: ACME POC — they want a clear recommendation on hosting mode, region, security answers, and measurable success criteria. Deadline EOD Thu. Key asks: EU data residency, ~10k/day (~100RPS burst), P95 latency target ~250ms for ~512-token responses, and a security questionnaire (SOC2/HIPAA flags). Can we align on: hosting choice (Hosted/Dedicated/Private), concrete acceptance tests (prompts/evals + perf), rough cost direction, and a 3–4 week timeline? cc @raj @dylan @anita

raj (Solutions): Thanks — quick qs: what model family do they want to run (LLama2-like, MPT, or a smaller distil)? Token distribution & avg prompt length? Those change batching and capacity. My initial thought: start Hosted in eu-west-1 for speed of setup, use a canary Dedicated pool if sustained 100 RPS required.

maria (AE): They asked for a Llama2-70B-ish quality baseline but open to 13B quantized if latency/cost wins. Typical prompts 30–120 tokens, responses up to 512 tokens. Mostly Q&A + small summarization. No PHI, but PII/sensitive customer data.

dylan (Eng): For 100 RPS with 512-token tails, Dedicated is the only way to guarantee p95 under 250ms unless we accept higher batching and slower tail latency on Hosted. A few options:
- Start Hosted (eu-west-1) to validate quality & evals quickly, then flip to Dedicated for load tests.
- If they insist on data isolation from day 1, Private (VPC) but adds setup time (2–3w).
We should also plan quantized model variants (8-bit/4-bit) and prefix KV caching.

anita (Security): Security Qs: do they require SOC2/HIPAA attestation in contract? KMS type (customer-managed vs Redwood), SIEM/Syslog integration, and whether logs must be redacted/pseudonymized. I can draft questionnaire responses but need confirmation on KMS and retention windows. Also confirm environment classification (restricted vs internal).

maria (AE): No HIPAA. SOC2 is required. They want customer-managed keys preferred, 365d audit log retention, and EU-only log residency.

raj (Solutions): Acceptance/POC success criteria proposal: 
- Functional: 200 curated prompts cover top 8 use cases; automated eval harness with pass/fail (>=90% relevancy/precision on labeled set).
- Perf: p95 latency <= 250ms for 512-token responses at 100RPS sustained (during load window), 99.9% availability during test window.
- Cost: estimate for baseline (13B quantized) vs 70B baseline; show cost delta for 1M tokens/day.
- Security: completed questionnaire + KMS key ownership + EU log residency confirmed.

dylan (Eng): Timeline I recommend:
- Week 0 (kick): infra + security prep (Hosted env or Dedicated capacity request), share eval prompts.
- Week 1: model onboarding + functional evals (200 prompts), iterate prompt templates.
- Week 2: load testing & latency tuning (batching/quantization), A/B if needed.
- Week 3: polish, run acceptance tests, handoff.
If they want Private, shift infra/setup into Week 0–1 and extend 1 week.

maria (AE): Customer wants POC done in 3 weeks if possible. They prefer Hosted to move fast but will accept Dedicated if we guarantee latency. Can we put concrete test commands and a short runbook for them to run?

dylan (Eng): Short deploy + eval snippet: 
```
# deploy dedicated (internal CLI)
redwood deploy --mode dedicated --region eu-west-1 --gpu a10g --capacity 2 --owner acme-poc

# run evals (local harness)
python eval_harness.py --prompts prompts_acme_200.json --model redwood/13b-quant --out results.json

# simple load test (k6)
k6 run --vus 100 --duration 5m load_test_script.js
```
Use EU region to satisfy residency. For Hosted, just switch --mode hosted and pick eu-west-1.

ops-bot: Runbook created: https://internal.redwood/sops/poc-runbooks/acme (contains deploy checklist, security checklist, and perf dashboards). Link auto-posted. :white_check_mark:

anita (Security): I'll prefill the security questionnaire (answers for SOC2, data residency, KMS, encryption at rest/in transit, pen-test status) and share by EOD tomorrow. I need the contact for their infosec to exchange the questionnaire. Also confirm whether they need an AICPA SOC2 report PDF — we can provide.

maria (AE): Infosec contact is sec-lead@acme.example.com. Please include a short note on KMS options: 1) Redwood-managed, 2) customer-managed (preferred).

raj (Solutions): For cost ballpark: 13B quantized on Dedicated (2x a10g) -> rough infra cost ~ $X/day (I'll put numbers in the deck). Hosted request will show per-token pricing; we should prepare both 1M token/day and 10M token/month scenarios.

dylan (Eng): Operational caveats: if they opt for batching >50ms, expect improved throughput but worse tail latency. Plan to enable prefix caching for repeated prompt prefixes (saves tokens). Also prepare a fallback policy: if Dedicated capacity is saturated, route to Hosted lower-cost instance with degraded latency (documented).

maria (AE): Action items: 
- raj: prep cost delta table (13B quantized vs 70B) + hosting pricing for 1M/day & 10M/mo by EOD tomorrow.
- dylan: create quick deploy + load test scripts in the runbook and a recommended Dedicated config for eu-west-1.
- anita: fill security questionnaire + gather SOC2 doc + confirm KMS options by EOD tomorrow.
- ops-bot: keep runbook link live and add a note about EU audit log retention.

maria (AE): Thanks team — plan to propose "Stage 1: Hosted eu-west-1 for quality + functional evals (1 week); Stage 2: Dedicated eu-west-1 capacity for load & SLA (week 2); Stage 3: Optional Private/VPC if they insist on customer-managed infra (add 1 week). I'll push that path in the customer call tomorrow. :rocket:"
